directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Current official Stadtwerke Schwabach public-charging tariff page for LadeVerbundPlus charging points
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The current official page explicitly labels 0.70 EUR/kWh AC and 0.85 EUR/kWh DC as Ad-hoc-Laden and publishes the blocking-fee matrix. Roaming and registered LadeVerbundPlus tariffs remain separate products.

reason: Current official operator page provides exact ad-hoc AC/DC energy prices and exact blocking-fee rules for the operator's LadeVerbundPlus charging surface, so no station-level extrapolation is required for this published tariff class.
